Boniface VIII.

[Benedetto Gaetani, born at Anagni about 1228; succeeded Celestine V. as Pope of Rome, 1294; became involved in a contest with Philip the Fair of France, whom he excommunicated, and by whom he was imprisoned; died soon after his release, 1303.]
Silence gives consent.
A favorite motto of the Pope, which he derived from the Canon Law, 
“Qui tacet, consentire videtur.”—Decretals,
 Book V., 12, 43.
